title: Token savings (rtk)
subtitle: Command output is condensed before an agent reads it — same behaviour, same exit codes, a fraction of the bytes.
allGood: Everything rtk needs is in place.

settings.title: Token savings (rtk)
settings.description: rtk is a CLI proxy that filters noise out of command output before an agent reads it. It is a binary on your machine: with it installed, WorkPilot routes the commands its agents run through it and tells them the output is condensed. Without it, nothing changes.
settings.enabledHint: Covers every agent: planner, coder, QA, spec, GitHub, self-healing and the rest. Costs nothing when rtk is not installed.
settings.modelFacingHint: The diffs and logs WorkPilot puts into a prompt itself. Never applied to output WorkPilot parses.
settings.notInstalled: rtk is not installed on this machine.
